notes: 15 cards: 4 origin and history cards (region, harvest festivals, the 1980s fusion, language), 4 instrument cards (dhol, tumbi, sarangi, sitar) plus the dhol-not-tabla misconception the content states, 4 term-to-definition (fusion, chaal, call and response, sampling), and 2 style cards (fast tempo, verse–chorus). The long exam feature list was split into single-fact cards so no answer is an enumeration, and the two film case studies were left to the film fusion deck.
